title.narrative: Enhancing Community Landscape Management to Reduce Deforestation and Biodiversity Loss in Tai-Grebo Transboundary Forest

description.narrative: Overall objective: At the end of the project, biodiversity loss and deforestation are reduced for rural communities on the edge of the Grebo-Krahn forest area in Liberia.Project goal: The target groups use their acquired knowledge to improve land management and reduce biodiversity loss and deforestation in the Grebo-Krahn forest area.

The Krahn-Tai-Grebo National Forest in Liberia is one of the remaining contiguous forest areas in the Upper Guinea Ecoregion. Charcoal production and mining as the main source of income for household survival continue to undermine the preservation of the forest. Farmers lack adequate alternative sources of income. The unregulated use of the forest area for livelihoods poses a threat to the National Forest Reserve. Partner: Society for Environmental Conservation.
The project will target 7,600 direct persons and 30,400 indirect persons comprising of 70% women and 30% men.
